exposure: Child death due to Complex Congenital Heart Disease (CCHD) in Pediatric Intensive Care Units (PICU)
cohort: The study included 18 bereaved parents whose children died from Complex Congenital Heart Disease (CCHD) at a tertiary cardiac center.
finding: Bereaved parents' experiences underscore the need for improved communication strategies, greater parental involvement in care, and enhanced bereavement support for children with CCHD.
